'''Sparkrow''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Scorchwing]] at 5 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Do not make eye contact with Sparkrow for more than a second. Anything longer is considered a challenge. After that, start worrying about dodging fireballs."

Sparkrow is an early game, blue rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Sparkrow is a small round red bird, with a fire-colored tail. It has an angry expression, with dark tufts of feathers that branch off the sides of its eyes. Its underbelly is white, and it has a dark brown almost black beak. Its eyes are a light yellow with dark brown pupils.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Every little Sparkrow dreams of flying high in the sky and raining down fireballs on its enemies."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Despite a small and delicate appearance, Sparkrow is extremely ferocious and will actively attack any creature that draws near."

==Strategy==
[[File:Sparkrow Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Sparkrow's attack range]]
Good early game DPS, use to counter grass types until a stronger fire Tatari is acquired.
